$comment: GATE FIXTURE, not site content. scripts/theme-doctor.py's --browser check serves this in place of the real game feed (raw.githubusercontent.com/estevanhernandez-stack-ed/626-game-manifest) when it opens mod-launcher-games.html. Without it that page renders its fetch-failed fallback under the gate's third-party isolation, and its populated layout — the featured cover rail and the two long game-row lists — is never checked for horizontal scroll. It does NOT need to track the real feed's contents; it needs to exercise the same SHAPES. Deliberately includes the longest real game name in the feed, an unbroken-token name, and one entry per tier, because a name that cannot wrap is what overflows a narrow viewport. schemaVersion must stay in step with what the page validates.
